# Sampling regression fixtures

legacy_sampling.json / .npz freeze the pre-low-speed sampler at seed 123, 10000 CPU environments, iteration 5674, and reset sequence true/false/false. Stored arrays are independent expected outputs, not regenerated by the current implementation. Source snapshot SHA256: 100a1659e2a79154041fabb11d8346ba695313d70bd24d9e2dbe67bae12c6b87.

transition_sampling.json contains only numeric sampling settings from the approved transition experiment. No fixture reads local logs, policies, media or output directories. Update golden arrays only after reviewing the intended sampling change.

low_speed_sampling.json freezes the numeric acceptance/sampling specification. gait_clock.npz contains only commands, gait_cycles and periods needed to score response deadlines; no full poses or local training assets are needed. Original full motion SHA256: f8ef8b55208eb5f74aa13dd9b699813081796aa9b43951b8bb1293b291c3d38b.

lateral_symmetry_manifest.json contains only the31 audited anatomical joint names/axes/limits, eight keypoint names and the lateral clip clock offsets. It exercises physical mirror conventions without opening local USD assets or loading policies.
